proof_body:
by
  intro K n _ _
  have h2 : ∀ a : K, a = -a → a = 0 := by
    intro a ha
    have h3 : (2 : K) * a = 0 := by
      rw [two_mul]
      nth_rw 1 [ha]
      simp
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left (NeZero.ne 2)
  let φ : LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.so (Fin n) K →ₗ[K] ({p : Fin n × Fin n // p.1 < p.2} → K) :=
    { toFun := fun A p => (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) p.1.1 p.1.2
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  have hφ : Function.Bijective φ := by
    constructor
    · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro A hA
      have hskew : (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K).transpose = -(A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) := (LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.mem_so (Fin n) K A).mp A.2
      have hs : ∀ i j, (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) j i = -(A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) i j := fun i j => by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun hskew i) j
      have hu : ∀ i j, i < j → (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) i j = 0 := fun i j hij => congrFun hA ⟨(i, j), hij⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext i j
      rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
      · exact hu i j h
      · subst h
        exact h2 _ (hs i i)
      · change (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) i j = 0
        rw [hs j i, hu j i h, neg_zero]
    · intro f
      let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K := Matrix.of fun i j => if h : i < j then f ⟨(i, j), h⟩ else if h' : j < i then -f ⟨(j, i), h'⟩ else 0
      have hB : B ∈ LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.so (Fin n) K := by
        rw [LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.mem_so]
        ext i j
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, B, Matrix.of_apply]
        rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
        · simp [h, not_lt_of_gt h]
        · subst h
          simp
        · simp [h, not_lt_of_gt h]
      refine ⟨⟨B, hB⟩, ?_⟩
      ext p
      simp [φ, B, p.2]
  have h1 := (LinearEquiv.ofBijective φ hφ).finrank_eq
  rw [h1, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]
  have h3 : Fintype.card {p : Fin n × Fin n // p.1 < p.2} = Fintype.card (Σ j : Fin n, Fin (j : ℕ)) := by
    apply Fintype.card_congr
    exact
      { toFun := fun p => ⟨p.1.2, ⟨p.1.1, p.2⟩⟩
        invFun := fun q => ⟨(⟨q.2, q.2.2.trans q.1.2⟩, q.1), q.2.2⟩
        left_inv := fun p => rfl
        right_inv := fun q => rfl }
  rw [h3, Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => i) n, Finset.sum_range_id]
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (n : ℕ) [Field K] [NeZero (2 : K)], Module.finrank K (LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.so (Fin n) K) = n * (n - 1) / 2
